name: day-after-tomorrow
description: Day After Tomorrow sits on a Finsbury Park lawn. Companion voice: you cannot change what is already here. Withdraw investment. Sit as awareness. Choose identity. Only later is yours. Pin id is STAR objective title and NFT trailPinId. Audio is a placeholder until Aether.

properties.title: Park cafe
properties.narrationText: Optional stop. Placeholder offer: mention Field Guide sit at the counter. Completing a sit does not require this cafe.
properties.directionHint: Public cafe in the park, west of Manor House gate. Skip it if you are sitting.

properties.title: Still Stone
properties.narrationText: You cannot change what is already here. Sit with it. Do not argue. Do not unpack the other person. Placeholder audio until the guided sit is recorded.
properties.directionHint: From Manor House gate, walk north into the gardens, then sit on the open lawn.

properties.title: Withdrawn Coin
properties.narrationText: Notice where attention is still out there: the name, the thread, the replay. Bring the coin back. Do not draft the message. Placeholder audio until the guided sit is recorded.
properties.directionHint: Same lawn as Still Stone. Sit when the previous token is in your wallet.

properties.title: Empty Bowl
properties.narrationText: The story can sit in the bowl. You sit as the space that holds it. Do not become the plot. Placeholder audio until the guided sit is recorded.
properties.directionHint: Same lawn. Empty Bowl unlocks when Withdrawn Coin is in the wallet.

properties.title: Chosen Seed
properties.narrationText: Feel the identity that already has the life you would pick. Imagination is practice, not getting them back. Placeholder audio until the guided sit is recorded.
properties.directionHint: Same lawn. Chosen Seed unlocks when Empty Bowl is in the wallet.

properties.title: Daybreak
properties.narrationText: Today still belongs to who you were. Only the day after tomorrow belongs to you. Walk as the one who owns later. Placeholder audio until the guided sit is recorded.
properties.directionHint: Same lawn. Daybreak unlocks when Chosen Seed is in the wallet.
